title: German Vegetable Gratin
description: A hearty German-inspired vegetable gratin, perfect for a cold winter night. This dish is a great way to use up a variety of vegetables and enjoy the comfort of a warm, cheesy casserole.
instructions: Peel and thinly slice the potatoes and carrots.
In a large saucepan, combine the vegetable broth and butter.
Bring the broth to a simmer and cook until the butter has melted.
Add the sliced potatoes and carrots to the saucepan and cook until they start to soften.
Transfer the potato and carrot mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish.
Top the potato and carrot mixture with the grated cheese.
Season the dish with salt and black pepper to taste.
Cover the dish with aluminum foil and bake for 25 minutes.
Remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 10-15 minutes, or until the top is golden brown.
Sprinkle with chopped parsley, if desired.
